exposure: Modified Robson's Ten Group classification system (RTGCS)
outcome: Contribution of Robson's Groups to CS rate
cohort: 260 women undergoing elective or emergency caesarean sections in a teaching institution.
finding: The overall caesarean section rate was 31.4%, with major contributions from Robson's Group 2 (21.5%), Group 10 (21.5%), and Group 5 (20.7%), and primary indications being prior LSCS (24.6%) and fetal distress (19.2%).
mod_finding: The study found an overall caesarean section rate of 31.4%, with specific Robson's Groups and indications identified as major contributors to the mode of birth.
